issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עַל הַגּוֹיִם וְעַל הַמַּמְלָכוֹת' means 'over the nations and over the kingdoms' (two distinct groups: nations and kingdoms). The Chinese '在列國和列國之上' renders both as '列國' (nations), dropping the distinction of 'kingdoms' (מַמְלָכוֹת) and repeating 'nations' instead. This changes the meaning by omitting the second category.
